## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 134 captures during March 2021. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available sessions supported the scheduled work, and no operational issue was identified in the information provided for this reporting period.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 134 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 0.7. The ungradable result should be considered when reviewing the overall activity and image-quality position for the month. No further image-quality concern is recorded in the report.

## Grading

A total of 28 captures were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed promptly during March 2021. The referable findings and grading lag should be reviewed alongside the activity and image-quality results when monitoring service performance at Central Eye Clinic.
